searchText: <nicoserranop> I got the double signing working in the frontend :D we just need to past the review and it would be merged and available at https://ceremony.ethereum.org/ I opened a PR in the sequencer code with a couple of functions I used to: 1. get potPubkeys 2. subgroup checks after contribution Could you take a look https://github.com/ethereum/kzg-ceremony-sequencer/pull/116 ? :) Hi, got a question about the sequencer. I am calling `try_contribute` and get `TryContributeError::AnotherContributionInProgress` Then, I am waiting 5 seconds to try again, but keep getting `TryContributeError::RateLimited` How many seconds is the minimum between `try_contribute` calls without getting rate limit errors? Couldn't see this in the spec <trent_vanepps> i like this NFT claim lobby <trent_vanepps> > <trent_vanepps> awesome work! (re @nicoserranop: I got the double signing working in the frontend :D we just need to past the review and it would be merged and available at https://ceremony.ethereum.org/ I opened a PR in the sequencer code with a couple of functions I used to: 1. get potPubkeys 2. subgroup checks after contribution Could you take a look https://github.com/ethereum/kzg-ceremony-sequencer/pull/116 ? :)) When can we start contributing to the ceremony? <trent_vanepps> > <trent_vanepps> we have a second audit starting next week, and then fixes after that. hope to launch before the end of the year (re @kzg_ceremony_bot: <KrabbyPatty> When can we start contributing to the ceremony?) Thank you!
